title: Single-metal atoms supported on HfBO MBenes for efficient overall water splitting
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19079-19087
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02327K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Meiling Pan, Xiuhua Cui, Qun Jing, Haiming Duan, Fangping Ouyang, Rong Wu
Single-atom TMs on h-MBene HfBO boost water splitting. Nb@HfBO shows Pt-like HER (ΔGH* = −0.01 eV). Ni@HfBO outperforms IrO2 in OER (η = 0.48 V). TM@HfBO offers noble-metal-free catalysis.
